title: Workely open data: Price Index and Open Ledger
description: Advertised prices for home-service trades read from businesses' own public price pages (the Workely Price Index; cells published only at 30 or more distinct businesses; no business named; robots.txt respected), and binned residential numbers from The Total Wash Co. in Madison, WI (the Open Ledger), plus a JSON Schema for owner pricing rules. The two series are kept separate and never blended. Updated quarterly.
